orchestration: GKE 1.36.4-gke.1247000 + Kueue v0.18.2 + JobSet v0.12.0 + Pathways (Trainer) + Single-Host TPU JobSet (Rollout, jobset.tpu.yaml) + Kubernetes Agent-Sandbox v1.0.4 (OpenHands)
precision: FP8 (e4m3fn) routed MoE experts: W8A8 in the Rollout and FP8 forward quantization of BF16 weights, with straight-through gradients, in the Trainer; FP8 routed-expert weight broadcast from Trainer to Rollout; BF16 attention, KV cache, non-routed layers, trainer collectives, and offline evaluation; FP32 router gate logits, output logits, gradient accumulation, and the AdamW first moment
checkpointing: model parameters (no optimizer state) after every step from step 6 (validation start) to step 10; each checkpoint records the time of its last weight update
trainer_topology: 1x tpu7x:4x4x8 (32 hosts, 128 TPU7x chips, 256 JAX devices; FSDP=32, TP=1, EP=2, CP=4, cp-as-ep)
rollout_topology: 128x tpu7x:2x2x1 (128 hosts, 512 TPU7x chips, 1024 JAX devices; DP=1, TP=1, EP=8 per replica)
weight_sync: Raiden DCN broadcast (asynchronous, in-flight weight updates, max_staleness=2)
optimizer: AdamW (constant lr=2.121320343559642e-06, warmup_steps=0, b1=0.9, b2=0.999, eps=1e-8, weight_decay=0.0, clip_by_global_norm=0.05892556509887896)
rl_algorithm: GRPO-LOO (token-mean loss, beta=0.0, clip_epsilon=[0.2, 0.28], seq-mask-tis=[0.999, 1.002], overlong_loss_masking=true, use_dynamic_sampling=false, data.shuffle=false)
training_rollout_sampling: temperature=1.0, top_p=1.0, top_k=null (-1), agent_max_turns=30, swebench_agent_timeout=1800, swebench_tests_timeout=60, command_exec_timeout=60
validation_rollout_sampling: temperature=0.1, top_p=0.95, top_k=null (-1), agent_max_turns=30, 4 attempts/task across 251 held-out R2E-Gym validation tasks (pass@4), offline BF16 checkpoint evaluation starting at step 6 (6,912 samples)
seed_source: 31-bit integer per run, set with SEED (run_and_time.sh draws one from /dev/urandom when SEED is unset; the scored runs set SEED explicitly), logged as MLLOG seed
